title: CapabilityProfile
description: What a specific device and app build can actually do right now: input and output modes it supports, hosts it can talk to, performance and battery limits, accessibility settings in effect, and how fresh the proof of all this is.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

id.description: Stable identifier for this capability profile.

device.description: The device this profile describes, e.g. model and identifier.

os.description: Operating system and version on the device.

appBuild.description: The exact app build this profile was measured against.

settings.description: Device or app settings that affect capability, as plain name-value pairs.

modalities.description: Input and output modes this device supports, e.g. 'voice', 'stylus', 'camera', 'nfc'.

hosts.description: Apps or services on this device that work can be handed to.

constraints.description: Current physical limits that affect what this device should be asked to do.

frameRate.description: Sustained display or capture frames per second the device can hold.

accessibilitySettings.description: Accessibility settings currently in effect, e.g. 'large-text', 'screen-reader', 'reduced-motion'.

lastVerifiedAt.description: When these capabilities were last actually proved on the device (ISO 8601). Stale profiles are not current proof.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the evidence that proved these capabilities.
